target_customer: Users and teams running heavy parallel workflows and AI agents on the web, including those on low powered devices
problem: Computers run one app in focus on one machine. Infinity runs each app on its own cloud computer with its own GPU so humans and agents can work in parallel from any browser.
business_model: Cloud computing platform accessed by browser; pricing not found
product_category: Cloud native operating system for agents (Infinity)

founders.name: Rounak Adhikary
education: BSc Design student at Lovely Professional University when the company drew attention (press)
Listed on YC page: Stanford ASES, Draper U, IIT Bombay
founders.background_notes: Described by press as a student founder; prior employers not listed

technical_complexity.rationale: Per app GPU isolated cloud computers streamed to a browser, running Windows and Linux, with low latency, is hard infrastructure for a small team, and compute costs are high.

defensibility.rationale: Orchestration and streaming know how helps, but cloud PC and agent browser vendors exist and the company relies on cloud GPU credits.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Agent browser infrastructure vendors are moving toward agents; no action against ProjectX reported.

market_need_then: Press in 2024 framed Infinity as bridging the digital divide for people with low powered devices; by 2026 the pitch shifted to agent workspaces as agents drive parallel work.

identity.visual_style: Product named Infinity under the ProjectX company name
identity.voice_and_tone: Bold manifesto copy: 'Run Anything On Everything'

branding.brand_signature: Infinity product name and 'Run Anything On Everything' tagline
branding.community_and_virality: Indian press coverage of the Google Cloud support in January 2024 and awards claimed by the company (Eureka IIT Bombay, Tiger Launch Global Finals)

brand_strength.rationale: Local press and award claims, but 'Project X' is a generic name and Infinity is a crowded product name; the site shows placeholder statistics.

pivots.from: Cloud OS to close the digital divide on low powered devices (2024 press)
pivots.to: Agent native workspace for parallel workflows (2026 YC page)
pivots.why: not stated; framing shift between 2024 press and 2026 YC listing

outcome_analysis: ProjectX began in 2022 as a student led cloud OS project in Kolkata, drew Google Cloud support in 2024, and joined YC in Spring 2026 with a pitch reframed around AI agents. Reported funding is small and conflicting, and its outcome is not yet known, so the YC batch and agent positioning are the main tests.
notes: Google Cloud support of $200,000 (about Rs 1.70 crore) was reported by several outlets in January 2024; some call it infrastructure support or credits, others a grant or funding, and CB Insights dates a Google Cloud pre-seed to 2025-08-28, so recorded as a grant round with cash vs credit unclear. A $3M seed target was reported in January 2024; no source confirms it closed. VCBacked lists $500K total and the company page claims $350K; both unverified. Competition at founding (2022) left empty: no dated 2022 competitor sources found; the competitor search returned only 2026 browser infrastructure vendors, which are named under takeover risk. Technical flag for Adhikary left null as sources do not say. The YC page lists a Stanford ASES, Draper U and IIT Bombay line without degrees. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff news found.
